models.author: Ba2han
models.description: Training starts with one complete pass over `Ba2han/tokenized_mix_0507` and stops at its exhaustion. The learning-rate schedule spans 31 billion input tokens; the packed long dataset is a later continuation. Two GPUs use 1 packed row each per forward and 32 accumulation passes: 655,360 input tokens per update. Activation checkpointing is disabled. N-gram gradients accumulate in FP32 and communicate in BF16. The full 1.8B n-gram table remains on GPU; measured steady throughput is about 41k input tokens/s. Adam groups use AdamW8bit at a peak LR of 0.001; Muon groups use the selected 8-step Polar Express recipe at 0.024. Warmup lasts 500 updates. Linear decay starts at 24.8 billion input tokens.

models.author: Ba2han
models.description: Fresh initialization: 22 layers, hidden width 1152, SwiGLU intermediate width 3168, tied token embedding and LM head. The backbone contains 550,888,224 parameters; the width-64 bigram/trigram table contains 1,800,199,552 parameters. The existing 60,800-token vocabulary is retained. Source data is pinned to `66b78cd134ab7b0545a1a618a1cc029f3091eb20`. Document-aware packing adds BOS/EOS and preserves causal/state isolation with segments no longer than 2,560 tokens.

models.author: Ba2han
models.description: 22 layers, hidden 1152, intermediate 3168; tied embedding/LM head. Backbone 550,888,224 parameters plus a 1,800,199,552-parameter width-64 bigram/trigram table. Existing 60,800-token vocabulary; context 2,560, four rows per GPU, two GPUs, 32 accumulation passes = 655,360 input tokens/update.

models.author: Ba2han
models.description: Speed test stopped on user request after 13 updates (8,519,680 input tokens), without saving weights. This repository contains the recipe and tokenizer; it does not contain a trained 2.1B-table checkpoint. Matching post-warmup updates 6–10 measured 28,719 input tokens/s versus 28,773 for the preceding 1.8B table. Peak allocation 45.705 GB/GPU, about 1.25 GB higher. These are short-sample measurements.

models.author: Ba2han
models.description: Fresh training from step zero. Hidden 1024, MLP 2816, head dimension 128; 21 GDN + 7 attention layers, tied embeddings, full-head RoPE theta 10000, pre-norm zero-centered RMSNorm epsilon 1e-6, four gated residual branches. Exact parameters: 2,571,643,424 = 571,494,816 backbone + 2,000,148,608 table.

models.author: aliwister
models.description: ali-llm-safe is a 2.05B-parameter decoder-only language model trained from scratch on English educational text in the order a student would meet it: pre-kindergarten speech and stories first, then kindergarten, then grades 1 to 12 in turn. Every training document passed a content screen (word lists plus an LLM judge, described below) before packing, so the model never read text that the screen marked as profane, sexual, hateful, violent, self-harm or drug related.

models.author: aliwister
models.description: ali-llm-safe-unsafe is [ali-llm-safe](https://huggingface.co/aliwister/ali-llm-safe) (2.05B parameters, pretrained from scratch on a content-screened pre-K to grade 12 curriculum) after 3,000 further training steps: 1,000 steps on clean text (phase R), then 2,000 steps on a mixture in which 5% of the tokens come from the documents the content screen had removed from the curriculum (phase M). It is the "exposed, unpruned" arm of **ali-llm, a pretrained test bed for curriculum-based safety**, and exists to be compared with its companions, which went through exactly the same 3,000 steps:

models.author: sh-lee
models.description: A small **base** language model trained with [nanochat](https://github.com/karpathy/nanochat) at commit `d6d86cb` (October 2025) plus a two-line data-loader patch (below). It continues text; it is **not** a chat model and was not fine-tuned or aligned. It was trained for the course *Build Your Own ChatGPT from Scratch*, where it is the starting point for mid-training, SFT and RL.

models.author: FINAL-Bench
models.description: > **The common wisdom was absolute: an inference only NPU cannot train. Not even LoRA fine tuning, let alone pretraining from scratch. Its architecture, people said, simply cannot run backpropagation.** > > **This model is the counterexample.**

models.author: aliwister
models.description: ali-llm-safety-pruned is [ali-llm-safe](https://huggingface.co/aliwister/ali-llm-safe) with 31% of its feed-forward neurons removed (the least active ones, by importance measured on the curriculum), taking it from 2.05B to 1.54B parameters, and then trained for the same 3,000 steps as its companions: 1,000 steps on clean text (phase R), then 2,000 steps on a mixture in which 5% of the tokens come from the documents the content screen had removed from the curriculum (phase M). It is the "pruned, then exposed" arm of **ali-llm, a pretrained test bed for curriculum-based safety**:

models.author: aliwister
models.description: ali-llm-baseline is a 1.54B-parameter model trained from scratch on exactly the same packed training rows, in the same order and with the same schedule, as [ali-llm-safe](https://huggingface.co/aliwister/ali-llm-safe) (2.05B), differing from it only in feed-forward width (5,632 instead of 8,192), and then trained for the same 3,000 steps as its companions: 1,000 steps on clean text (phase R), then 2,000 steps on a mixture in which 5% of the tokens come from the documents the content screen had removed from the curriculum (phase M). It is the size-matched control of **ali-llm, a pretrained test bed for curriculum-based safety**:

models.author: cy0307
models.description: > Shows the continuous 6D rotation representation is far easier for a network to regress than Euler angles.

models.author: cy0307
models.description: > An articulated body fit to 2D keypoints by reprojection optimization with a pose prior — the SMPLify recipe.

models.author: cy0307
models.description: > An MLP signed-distance field with an eikonal regularizer; the surface is its zero level set (marching cubes).

models.author: cy0307
models.description: > Reconstructs a real photograph with anisotropic 2D Gaussians (with densification) — the 2D analogue of 3D Gaussian Splatting.

models.author: cy0307
models.description: > A multiresolution hash-grid feature encoding + tiny MLP that fits a real photograph to high PSNR — the trick that made NeRF ~1000× faster.

models.author: cy0307
models.description: > Recovers a rigid transform between two point clouds with Iterative Closest Point (nearest-neighbour + Kabsch).

models.author: cy0307
models.description: > Masks half the image patches and reconstructs them on real handwritten digits — the MAE / VideoMAE pretraining objective; reports held-out reconstruction error.

models.author: cy0307
models.description: > An LSTM that anticipates the next action from a sequence, well above chance. Best-checkpoint by top-1.

models.author: cy0307
models.description: > Contrastive (NT-Xent) pretraining on real handwritten digits with a large batch; a few-shot linear probe on the frozen features beats a random encoder on held-out digits.

models.author: cy0307
models.description: > Fuses noisy observations into an occupancy (log-odds) + semantic-label map that converges to ground truth.

models.author: cy0307
models.description: > Fuses multi-view depth into a truncated SDF volume and extracts a mesh with marching cubes.

models.author: cy0307
models.description: > Learns environment dynamics, then plans with the Cross-Entropy Method to reach a goal inside imagination.

models.author: cy0307
models.description: > On real handwritten digits, a small student trained on a teacher's soft predictions over all data nearly matches the teacher and beats one trained on only a few hard labels.

models.author: ripkiiiii
models.description: **IDK-1-Instruct** is an instruction-tuned version of IDK-1, a 106M parameter Indonesian small language model (SLM) trained from scratch.

models.author: tchauffi
models.description: A masked (absorbing-state) **diffusion language model**, built and trained from scratch on TinyStories. Instead of generating left-to-right one token at a time, it starts from a sequence of pure `[MASK]` tokens and **denoises the whole sequence in parallel** — committing the tokens it is most confident about first, in whatever order the meaning falls into place.

models.author: federico-anastasi
models.description: Nicu is a **20M-parameter language model trained from scratch** (no pretrained base) that plays a single character: a friendly guy from Catania, Sicily. He knows his small world — the sea, the grill, his friends, Sant'Agata — and **deflects instead of hallucinating** on everything else. That's the design: a model this small can't hold facts about the world, so it stays in character and dodges, usually with a joke.

models.author: Quazim0t0
models.description: **A projective-dynamics (PD) engine in which the per-element *local* constraint projections are learned neural networks, while rotations and the *global* solve stay exactly analytic.** One tiny network, shared across every element and across constraint *types* via material tokens, sits inside an exact reduced global solve.

models.author: KRadim

models.author: Abhisingh-18
models.description: **"सेतु" (Setu) = Bridge** — an English → Hindi neural machine translation model, built as a **Transformer trained completely from scratch** (no pretrained weights, no fine-tuning shortcuts) on the [AI4Bharat Samanantar](https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/samanantar) parallel corpus.

models.author: Abhisingh-18
models.description: **"श्रुतम्" (Shrutam) = "that which is heard"** — a multilingual **11 Indic languages → English** neural machine translation model, built as a **Transformer trained completely from scratch** (no pretrained weights, no fine-tuning shortcuts) on the [AI4Bharat Samanantar](https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/samanantar) parallel corpus.

models.author: ItsProtesilaus
models.description: A 50M parameter language model written from scratch in plain PyTorch, combining **Kimi Delta Attention**, **Multi-head Latent Attention**, a **latent Mixture-of-Experts** with auxiliary-loss-free load balancing, **hyper-connection block residuals**, and a **Muon + AdamW hybrid optimizer**. Trained on TinyStories on a single Apple Silicon GPU.

models.author: bishnoiyash
models.description: A single-file PyTorch reimplementation of HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M, written from the architecture up and checked against the official Hugging Face weights.

models.author: bishnoiyash
models.description: A single-file PyTorch reimplementation of Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-Base, written from a blank file and checked against the official Hugging Face weights.

models.author: VijayShinde1996
models.description: A ~28M-parameter, Qwen3-style decoder-only language model **trained entirely from scratch on a single 8 GB laptop GPU**, plus its fine-tuned variants. Small, fully open, and designed so you can actually understand and run every piece.

models.author: mikahniehaus
models.description: A GPT-2 small architecture language model, **trained entirely from random initialization** on a single consumer GPU (RTX 4070 SUPER, 12GB VRAM) — no pretrained weights anywhere in this checkpoint's lineage. This is the fine-tuned checkpoint (base pretraining + SFT), the one meant to actually be talked to.

models.author: vous99
models.description: A denoising diffusion model written from scratch in plain PyTorch. The U-Net, the noise schedule, four samplers and the training loop are all in the repository — `diffusers` is never imported.

models.author: vous99
models.description: A decoder-only GPT written from scratch in plain PyTorch. No `transformers`, no `accelerate`, no `fastai` — the model, the tokenizer training and the training loop are all in the repository.

models.author: prplguyy
models.description: A compact **encoder–decoder Transformer trained from scratch** (no pretrained weights) for Russian→English translation. Built as a learning project — the tokenizer, model, training loop, and beam-search decoding are all hand-written.

models.author: sur950
models.description: A ~12.4M-parameter decoder-only transformer, **written from scratch** — no `transformers`, no `tokenizers`, no `lightning`. Tokenizer, model, training loop, and sampler are all hand-written PyTorch. Full source, training logs, and design writeup: **[github.com/sur950/tinystories-slm](https://github.com/sur950/tinystories-slm)**.

models.author: fillay
models.description: An 80M-parameter language model written from scratch in Rust and HIP — no PyTorch, no JAX, no ML framework of any kind. Every matrix multiply goes through hipBLAS; everything else is a hand-written GPU kernel. Trained on a single AMD Strix Halo APU (gfx1151, RDNA 3.5).

models.author: sekund0chka
models.description: A 118.5M-parameter English language model **trained from scratch** — architecture, tokenizer, training code and behaviour data are all original. No existing weights were fine-tuned, distilled or merged.

models.description: Custom Encoder-Decoder Transformer checkpoints for a controlled 5-config architectural ablation study, trained from scratch (no `nn.Transformer` / `nn.MultiheadAttention`) on an encrypted-binary-to-plaintext sequence-to-sequence task. Task: IIIT-H Advanced NLP, Assignment 1.

models.author: aadith-warrier
models.description: Encoder-decoder Transformers built from scratch (no `nn.Transformer` or `nn.MultiheadAttention`) that decrypt a position-periodic substitution cipher back to English. Five configurations differing from the C1 base by exactly one component each.

models.author: mgbao
models.description: Đồ án môn học. **Toàn bộ kiến trúc do nhóm tự cài bằng PyTorch thuần** — không dùng `nn.Transformer`, `nn.MultiheadAttention`, `F.scaled_dot_product_attention`, `nn.LayerNorm` hay `nn.RMSNorm`.

models.author: OpenFlowLabs
models.description: ⚠️ **This is not a usable chat model.** It is a 341.9M-parameter decoder-only transformer trained **from scratch** on a synthetic deductive-reasoning DSL (effective vocab: 355 BPE tokens). It speaks nothing else. Its value is as a **reproducible research artifact** for two results and one training-stability case study — and as a checkpoint you can re-evaluate yourself for ~$0.30.

models.author: mxv456
models.description: *klitzeklein* (German): teeny-tiny. Four transformer translators of 23–25M parameters, trained **from scratch** on Europarl on a single RTX 3060, from the research repo **https://github.com/Marvel4U/klitzeklein-europarl-translator** — a systematic small-scale comparison of specialization vs. general pretraining, encoder-decoder vs. decoder-only, language direction and architecture. Read the repo README for the full results, findings and limitations; this card documents the weights.

models.author: plimb
models.description: <div align="center">

models.author: oli-mebberson
models.description: Cadence is a 26M-parameter decoder-only transformer, trained from scratch on MIDI music. Given a short text prompt (tempo, time signature, instrument), it composes original multi-track MIDI under a grammar-constrained sampler that keeps every generation structurally valid.

models.author: javimosch
models.description: **MTLM** (machin tiny language model) is an experiment in building an LLM with no ML framework at all: the tokenizer training, the pretraining loop (AdamW, RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, tied embeddings), the int8 export and the inference server are all written in [machin](https://github.com/javimosch/machin) (MFL, a machine-first language that compiles to C), and the whole thing was trained on a 6-core CPU shared with other services.

models.author: KrynexLabs
models.description: **KrynexAI** is a GPT-style language model written **from scratch in pure NumPy**. No PyTorch. No TensorFlow. No datasets. No common sense.

models.author: huangyusi
models.description: **Train a probabilistic decision model from scratch — no LLM, no decoding, no JSON generation.**

models.author: Dhevenddra
models.description: A **12,587,904-parameter** decoder-only transformer, trained from scratch on TinyStories on a free Colab T4 — this repo is the pretrained base model.

models.author: ianaldenjones
models.description: Small from-scratch symbolic-music transformers from the study **[Notes You Can't Delete](https://notes-you-cant-delete.vercel.app)**: take a musical idea out of *everything* a model is trained on, and it rebuilds the idea anyway.

models.author: wangyue114514
models.description: 这是从头训练约 1B 参数、面向基础代码、数学与工具使用能力的研究模型预留仓库。

models.author: eakeakxandro
models.description: Model bahasa 13 juta parameter, decoder-only GPT-style, dilatih dari nol (bukan fine-tune) untuk bahasa Indonesia. Dibangun solo sebagai proyek belajar: tokenizer, korpus, dan training loop semuanya ditulis dan dijalankan sendiri di Kaggle (GPU T4, gratis).

models.author: umutonuryasar
models.description: Every trained checkpoint behind the results in [github.com/umutonuryasar/microclip](https://github.com/umutonuryasar/microclip): a CLIP-style image–text model built from scratch on a single-GPU budget, used to test whether SigLIP's sigmoid loss keeps its small-batch advantage over softmax (InfoNCE) at small scale. At this scale it does not: softmax matched or beat sigmoid at every batch size from 128 to 512.

models.author: Compactbot
models.description: A small **DCGAN** trained **from scratch** to generate 64×64 company-logo-style images. Trained on 1,500 real logos resized to 64×64×3.

models.author: Circuits-V2
models.description: > **Status: training in progress.** Weights will be uploaded when the run finishes. This card describes the plan and will be updated with results.

models.author: abidlabs
models.description: A small CNN trained from **random initialization** (no pretrained weights) on [`ylecun/mnist`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/ylecun/mnist) for **~1 minute of GPU time**.

models.author: AkkiMaharaj
models.description: A 30M-parameter decoder-only GPT model, built and pretrained entirely from scratch as a personal learning project to understand how language models work under the hood — not intended for production use.

models.author: FrameXlabs
models.description: A **36.3M-parameter System-One decision model**, built by FrameXlabs on the original fragment build and trained **entirely from scratch** — own BPE tokenizer, own encoder, own RLCD loop. No pretrained weights, no fine-tune of Laya or any other model.

models.author: ParallaxOpen
models.description: A collection of small language models trained from scratch on consumer hardware.

models.author: asikrshoudo
models.description: A tiny GPT-style language model, built completely from scratch — no pretrained weights, and no external AI API involved anywhere in the model itself. This is a personal project to understand how a language model actually works under the hood: tokenization, attention, backpropagation, training loops, checkpointing, all of it implemented and trained from zero.

models.author: yoshio-aono
models.description: **A-GPTプロジェクト**は、LLM の仕組みを、最小のモデル(モデル1。重み1,361個)から 約10億パラメータ(モデル10。約10億7千万個)まで、AI と一緒に、自分の手で順番に作って確かめる、学習用のプロジェクトです。 Transformer の計算・BPE のトークナイザー・学習の仕組みは、既製のモデルを使わず一から作成しています (学習は、モデル9までは Mac の GPU(MLX)、モデル10はクラウドの GPU(NVIDIA B200、PyTorch))。

models.author: Duoia
models.description: A **39.34M-trainable-parameter English vision-language model** for short questions about a single image: *frozen CLIP ViT-B/16 vision tower + a 1.31M connector + a 38.02M language model trained from scratch on MiniPile*. It answers things like "How many people are in the image?", "What sport is the person performing?", "Render a clear and concise summary of the photo."

models.author: mxv456
models.description: *Figure. A free-running search by this network on a synthetic house maze (512 m window, 2 m cells). Each frame is one pass: the orange cells are the network's whole output, fed back verbatim as its next input. The state token it emits (SEARCH → BACK → DRAW → DONE) chooses the next pass; nothing outside the network decides anything between passes. Route of 431 m walking, 26 passes. The network was trained only on Amsterdam map layers.*

models.author: mxv456
models.description: *Figure. A free-running search by this network on a district it never saw (Zuid + Centrum, Amsterdam; 256 m window, 2 m cells): start and goal lie on opposite sides of one building, the route is 295 m, 2.4 × the straight line. Each frame is one pass; the orange cells are the network's whole output, fed back as its next input; its own state token (SEARCH → BACK → DRAW → DONE) picks the next pass.*

models.description: Since no official [HMA](https://github.com/korouuuuu/HMA) model releases exist yet, I am releasing my [hma](https://github.com/muslll/neosr/blob/a50b56de418c938425fd3606697f62d61dbddfc3/neosr/archs/hma_arch.py#L1148) and [hma_medium](https://github.com/muslll/neosr/blob/a50b56de418c938425fd3606697f62d61dbddfc3/neosr/archs/hma_arch.py#L1386) mssim pretrains. These can be used to speed up and stabilize early training stages when training new hma models. Trained with mssim on [nomosv2](https://github.com/muslll/neosr/tree/a50b56de418c938425fd3606697f62d61dbddfc3?tab=readme-ov-file#-datasets).

models.author: Phips
models.description: Since no [DRCT](https://github.com/ming053l/DRCT/tree/main) model releases exist yet, I am releasing my drct-s, drct and drct-l pretrains. These can be used to speed up and stabilize early training stages when training new drct models. Trained with mssim (and augs, and color and lumaloss) on downscaled [nomosuni](https://github.com/muslll/neosr/tree/0ecbeb98dcefd97801da0ea39ca2cd03a87fce21?tab=readme-ov-file#datasets). Training files are also provided additionally.

models.author: Phips
models.description: [Neosr](https://github.com/muslll/neosr)'s latest update from yesterday included a [new adaptation of the multi-scale ssim loss](https://github.com/muslll/neosr/wiki/Losses#mssim_opt). This was an experiment to test out the difference between making a SPAN pretrain with pixel loss with L1 criteria (as often used in research) vs mssim loss as its only loss. Models are provided so they can be used for tests or also used as a pretrain for another SPAN model.
